overview_description.description: DoDo is the smart delivery service specializing in last-mile and same-day delivery of goods to the end customer. DoDo is currently the technological leader with its data-driven solution and agile processes. We already managed to ensure long-term contracts and pilot projects with multiple high-profile retail and gastro customers ensuring us a substantial turnover growth and margins. In DoDo we plan to invest in its SW system architecture to further optimize the delivery process based on big data, AI and automatization. The goal is to be the prime provider with its scalable solution. Same-day-delivery is expected to be an important service for all retail players and DoDo plans to continue with the acquisition of these clients especially in the Central European region. The indisputable advantage is easy implementation into the existing solution. Our flexible procedures and processes are easily adaptable to meet exactly what partner´s business needs. DoDo is managing over 600+ cars, 1300+ couriers in 4 countries.

about_short_description.short_description: DoDo is an E-commerce platform that specializes in logistics and delivery of grocery orders on the same day.

product.name: Last Mile Delivery Service
product.description: Same-day delivery service that delivers grocery and other e-commerce orders within 90 minutes, including delivery to the customer's door or upstairs.

product.name: GAIA Logistics Platform
product.description: A proprietary data-driven logistics platform that optimizes route planning, capacity utilization, and real-time operations management for last mile delivery.

product.name: DODO Partner Franchise Program
product.description: A franchise program enabling entrepreneurs to operate last mile delivery services using DoDo's technology, vehicles, and client base.

product.name: Slot-Based Delivery Service
product.description: Delivery service offering customers the ability to select precise delivery time windows, starting from 30-minute intervals, for e-commerce orders.

product.name: Express Food Delivery
product.description: Delivery service specialized in transporting food orders from restaurants and food outlets to customers, ensuring freshness and timely arrival.

product.name: Oversized and Heavy Item Delivery
product.description: Delivery service for large or heavy packages requiring two couriers and specialized vehicles, including delivery inside premises and basic installation.
